svg.title: Chen–Sun immortal compact flow: three finite stages and the double-sphere limit
svg.desc: Original schematic, not computed PDE time slices. Blue and ochre sheets meet at two polar necks. Neck circles remain positive at every finite stage. The limit is a single sphere counted twice. Lower panels show the closed orbit-space profiles. The radial coordinate map (p,y) to (1+2y)p distorts the product metric.

g.text: Radial drawing; product metric is not preserved.
